changeSet.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS cecairbar_person_id_seq AS BIGINT MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 99999999 NO CYCLE

SELECT setval('cecairbar_person_id_seq', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(ua.value FROM 5) AS BIGINT)) FROM user_attribute ua WHERE ua.name = 'personId' AND ua.value ~ '^PER-[0-9]{8}$'), 0) + 1, false)
